sources.title: Permanent Exhibition | Edo-Tokyo Museum
facts: The Edo Zone covers warrior culture and townspeople's lives with full-scale historical reconstructions and objects.
An independently inspected official search excerpt describes Bigot prints in the interpretation of Meiji everyday life.
limitations: The permanent-exhibition page was the sole museum page opened; special exhibitions were visible only in official search excerpts.
The returned open excerpt was partial; modern-era historical material alone does not settle modern-art relevance.
